requirements.statement: Generated authority, proposal Markdown, orientation, workflow output, temporary build output, caches, and runtime state SHALL NOT be written under repo/bootstrap/.
The canonical bootstrap entry point SHALL be executable shell wrapper repo/bootstrap/scripts/bootstrap invoked from repository root.
The bootstrap shell wrapper SHALL be limited to invocation concerns.
Once copied into the target repository, the bootstrap payload SHALL require no semantic, template, generator, or script input from the originating bootstrap environment.
Bootstrap SHALL install the complete successor repo-spec Design Proposal seed set before cutover.
Installed successor proposal.json and chunks/*.json SHALL be the canonical installed structured read representation.
After cutover, authoritative determination SHALL use accepted read surfaces outside repo/bootstrap/.
repo/bootstrap/ SHALL be the canonical non-authoritative maintenance source and generation implementation for FS0.
The installed FS0 repository SHALL contain the Design-defined fixed bootstrap layout.
Unknown maintained artifacts inside governed FS0 roots SHALL be rejected unless authorized by an explicit extension point.
The bootstrap lifecycle SHALL permit only candidate -> cutover and no reverse transition.
After cutover, bootstrap maintenance machinery SHALL NOT independently authorize mutation or create acceptance.

After cutover, FS0 SHALL complete bounded self-change through accepted authority, candidate publication, Conformance, Assurance, explicit acceptance, and accepted-state publication without the external bootstrap environment.
Every FS0 JSON record SHALL contain schema_version and record_type.
Each FS0 authority record SHALL contain schema_version, record_type authority, authority_id, title, owner, lifecycle_state, dependencies, delegates, requirements, and provenance.
Each installed requirement record SHALL contain requirement_id, owner_authority_id, statement, lifecycle_state, lineage where applicable, conformance_applicability, and assurance_applicability.

repo/state/bootstrap.json SHALL use record_type bootstrap-state and contain state, candidate revision where applicable, first accepted FS0 revision where applicable, bootstrap provenance issue, bootstrap acceptance record, accepted_ref, and cutover timestamp.

README.md SHALL state repository purpose, bootstrap/cutover status, Design Proposal index, accepted-state discovery guidance, basic operation guidance, and that implementation and GitHub state do not independently create authority.
AGENTS.md SHALL state initial reading order, Design-chunk discovery, bootstrap/cutover-state discovery, and accepted-state resolution after cutover.
Bootstrap verification SHALL fail if any required generated root orientation or license surface is absent.
